meta.title: Majed
meta.description: Bidirectional (RTL/LTR) text support for Arabic, Persian and Hebrew, GenUI RTL mirroring, and extra Settings > General options such as an app-UI font size.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions (Majed)
subscriptions.unreachable: The Subscriptions host component cannot be reached. Reconnect or check the component on the Plugins page.
subscriptions.coexistence: The reference plugin dsh-plugin-subscriptions is running too. Only one plugin can serve the shared provider ids (codex, claude, grok, copilot, antigravity) at a time; switch the reference plugin off before using providers from this component.
subscriptions.creditsUnavailable: Reset credits could not be verified.
subscriptions.confirmLogout: Log this account out? Its stored credentials will be removed.
subscriptions.resetAcknowledge: I understand that one credit will be consumed.
subscriptions.providerUnavailable: Codex unavailable: provider id already registered.
subscriptions.clientVersionHint: Requests present this CLI version, and newer models may require a recent one.
subscriptions.manualSummary: Browser flow not working? Paste the callback URL or code
subscriptions.addAccountHint: Browser authorization signs in whichever account the browser currently uses — switch accounts there first (or use an incognito window with the manual code below) to add a different one.
subscriptions.resetGuard: You can use this reset when weekly usage reaches at least 80%.
subscriptions.resetRefresh: Refresh usage to verify current limits and reset availability.
subscriptions.resetReady: Use this reset — the earliest-expiring credit. Confirmation required.
subscriptions.resetWarning: This consumes one credit and resets weekly + 5-hour limits. This interface cannot undo it. Confirmation expires in 60 seconds.
subscriptions.intro: Log a subscription provider in or out. Login opens the provider’s authorization page in a new tab; headless setups can paste the callback URL or code instead.
